prompt: Create a transparent-background 2-column by 2-row atlas for closed stone doorways. Row 1 is the necropolis source, row 2 the starter-dungeon source. Column 1 TOP, column 2 BOTTOM. References 1 and 2 are the exact canonical source sprites for each row. References 3 and 4 are root-reviewed same-state top/bottom orthographic geometry templates from another stone doorway; follow their narrow principal-plane silhouettes and scale, repainting from each target row's own source palette/material. TOP shows only the thin depth surfaces of the overhead lintel/arch crown, two narrow jamb cap footprints, and threshold line; no vertical arch opening, no door panel face, no frontal emblems. BOTTOM shows only shallow underside planes: two jamb foot caps and a horizontal lintel/arch soffit span. Because these are closed doorways, preserve the source state and panel/gap: for a closed doorway keep the door panel's underside as a narrow connected opaque strip; for an open doorway keep the center passage open beyond the shallow soffit band. Preserve necropolis gold/cream emblem style in row 1 and starter gray stone/wood identity in row 2; do not mix rows. Strict orthographic planes, no perspective, no full face-on arch or generic panel. One isolated asset per cell, centered with transparent gutters. Inferred, not recovered pixels or calibrated 3D.
